name: V_WORKFLOW_ROUTING
rationale: Operator-requested (2026-08-16): anything that improves workflow routing and produces clean workflows. This is the project's primary product axis and no existing driver means it — D1-D4 are the Constitutional directives and the five imported free drivers are AEF framework-development axes. Proposed drop F1 V_CONTEXT_FABRIC: measured 17/69 active tasks non-zero, mean 0.45, weakest contributor in the free set and specific to building a framework rather than a BPMN designer. NOTE: needs a dedicated score_ handler in estimator.py; the score_free_driver fallback is keyword-on-driver-id and scores 0 on all 55 non-inception tasks.

name: V_AEF_INTEGRATION
rationale: Operator-requested (2026-08-16): anything that improves integration into AEF. The 832-AEF seam is the arc's spine — contract plus fixture, BPMN mapping standard, producer-contract work — and it is currently scored by nothing. Proposed drop F3 V_PROMPT_QUALITY: measured 17/69 active tasks non-zero, mean 0.55, an axis for building an agentic framework rather than for a designer that consumes one. NOTE: needs a dedicated score_ handler in estimator.py; the score_free_driver fallback is keyword-on-driver-id and scores 0 on all 55 non-inception tasks.

name: V_SDLC_ENABLEMENT
rationale: Operator-requested (2026-08-16): anything that enhances workflow capability to support a software development process built on the workflows. This is the product thesis — workflows as the substrate a dev process runs on — and no current driver expresses it. Proposed drop F-AUTONOMY: measured 15/69 active tasks non-zero, mean 0.46, and it scores human-gate reduction inside an agentic framework, which is AEF's axis rather than this project's. NOTE: needs a dedicated score_ handler in estimator.py; the score_free_driver fallback is keyword-on-driver-id and scores 0 on all 55 non-inception tasks.
